all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 820 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 49 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 37.9°S, 166.4°E, about 750 km from Auckland.
This far north, they're roughly level with San Francisco, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 4,136 m below the ship, which is about 12.5 Eiffel Towers stacked up.
